map_spec.title: The Broken Tide Mill
map_spec.purpose: A 32 by 24 cell encounter map with two river crossings, a ruined mill and readable approach choices.

inspiration.premise: An abandoned tide mill controls a narrow watercourse; the bridge is exposed, while a shallow ford offers an alternate approach.

style.medium: Hand-painted fantasy encounter map with precise floor plans and restrained material texture.
style.linework: Clean dark boundaries for walls and water edges, softer marks for grass and worn earth.
style.surface_texture: Specific local wear and material grain; no uniform noise over all walkable spaces.
style.lighting: Even readable daylight, short soft shadows, no bloom or fog over movement paths.

environment.terrain_summary: A north-south watercourse divides grassy banks. The mill sits on the east bank. A stone bridge near the center and a shallow ford to the south both connect the west approach to the eastern terrace.

mill.name: The Tide Mill
mill.appearance: A roofless rectangular stone mill interior with broken walls, pale flagstones, one large grindstone and a dry work area. View every wall and floor vertically from above.
must_show: walls do not cover interior floor
must_avoid: a second floor drawn over the playable floor
mill.gameplay_role: Encounter objective with an enterable interior

waterwheels.name: Twin Waterwheels
waterwheels.appearance: Two large weathered wooden waterwheels attached to the mill west wall, readable from directly above with their axles pointing toward the mill.
waterwheels.gameplay_role: Distinctive industrial landmark and edge hazard

channel.name: The Millrace
channel.appearance: A continuous clear teal channel flowing from the north edge to the south edge, darker in the deeper center and shallow at the southern ford.

west_entry.name: West Approach
west_entry.appearance: A broad patch of dry packed earth with sparse grass and enough unoccupied floor for an arriving group.

bridge.name: The Stone Span
bridge.appearance: A short east-west stone bridge crossing the channel; its clear travel surface connects both banks. Low broken parapets provide partial cover without sealing the path.
must_show: at least two cells of clear width

ford.name: The Shallow Ford
ford.appearance: A shallow crossing of pale submerged stones with a readable line of travel across the channel, no deep-water gap.
must_show: at least three cells of passable width
visible shallows rather than a second bridge

east_terrace.name: The Work Terrace
east_terrace.appearance: An open paved work terrace on the east bank; broken edge stones frame the space but leave the central travel lane clear.
east_terrace.gameplay_role: Maneuvering and staging space before entering the mill

mill_entry.name: South Mill Doorway
mill_entry.appearance: A two-cell-wide opening in the south wall of the mill, without a door leaf or debris across the threshold.
must_show: an actual opening in the wall
mill_entry.gameplay_role: Access from the terrace to the mill interior

cover_blocks.name: Fallen Stone Blocks
cover_blocks.appearance: Three separate fallen sandstone blocks grouped along the eastern terrace edge, with gaps between them and no obstruction to the central approach.
cover_blocks.gameplay_role: Optional cover outside the central movement lane

hidden_cache.name: Hidden Axle Cache
hidden_cache.appearance: A concealed compartment beneath the workbench.
hidden_cache.gm_notes: A sealed note and a silver key are here. Neither the compartment outline nor its label belongs on the player map.

bridge_approach.appearance: A continuous dry approach across the bridge, with the road surface visible between pieces of rubble.

ford_approach.appearance: A continuous alternate approach through the shallow ford and back onto the eastern bank.

terrace_to_door.appearance: An unobstructed stone approach to the south doorway.

door_to_interior.appearance: An open threshold leading into the visible mill interior.

compiled.image_instructions:
DELIVERABLE
One battlemap map for tabletop play, 4:3 composition. True orthographic top-down plan; no horizon, vanishing point, perspective tilt or facade views.
Purpose: A 32 by 24 cell encounter map with two river crossings, a ruined mill and readable approach choices.
Working title (not automatically printed): The Broken Tide Mill.

INTENT AND COMPOSITION
Premise: An abandoned tide mill controls a narrow watercourse; the bridge is exposed, while a shallow ford offers an alternate approach.
Mood: quiet danger, ancient utility, clear tactical choices. Novelty: grounded.
Motifs: weathered limestone; oxidized bronze; clear teal water
A north-south watercourse divides grassy banks. The mill sits on the east bank. A stone bridge near the center and a shallow ford to the south both connect the west approach to the eastern terrace.
Primary visual anchor: The Tide Mill. Read in this order: The Tide Mill > The Stone Span > The Shallow Ford > The Work Terrace.
Keep critical content inside an edge safety inset of 2.5%. North is up. Coordinates below use image space: x left-to-right, y top-to-bottom; every percentage is relative to the complete canvas. These are layout instructions, not drawn coordinate labels.

VISUAL LANGUAGE
Hand-painted fantasy encounter map with precise floor plans and restrained material texture.
Linework: Clean dark boundaries for walls and water edges, softer marks for grass and worn earth.
Palette by role: bronze: #927443; grass: #7F8B60; shadow: #51584E; stone: #B7AD94; water: #4F7E80
Surface: Specific local wear and material grain; no uniform noise over all walkable spaces.
Lighting: Even readable daylight, short soft shadows, no bloom or fog over movement paths.
Detail density: balanced. Border: none. Concentrate small detail around important places; protect terrain silhouettes and readable routes.

ENVIRONMENT
Season: late summer. Time: afternoon. Weather: dry and clear. Physical logic: naturalistic. No unrequested supernatural geography.

REQUIRED MAP CONTENT
mill | The Tide Mill | room | primary | quantity 1. box left 57.0%, top 18.0%, width 23.0%, height 30.0%. A roofless rectangular stone mill interior with broken walls, pale flagstones, one large grindstone and a dry work area. View every wall and floor vertically from above.
Must show: roof removed; one circular grindstone; one obvious south doorway; walls do not cover interior floor.
Do not show here: an isometric facade; a second floor drawn over the playable floor.
Spatial function: Encounter objective with an enterable interior.

bridge | The Stone Span | bridge | supporting | quantity 1. box left 34.0%, top 57.0%, width 28.0%, height 10.0%. A short east-west stone bridge crossing the channel; its clear travel surface connects both banks. Low broken parapets provide partial cover without sealing the path.
Must show: at least two cells of clear width; both ends meet dry ground.
Spatial function: Fast exposed crossing.

channel | The Millrace | river | supporting | quantity 1. box left 39.0%, top 2.5%, width 11.0%, height 95.0%. A continuous clear teal channel flowing from the north edge to the south edge, darker in the deeper center and shallow at the southern ford.
Shape path: (44.5% across, 3.0% down) -> (44.5% across, 20.0% down) -> (44.0% across, 40.0% down) -> (45.0% across, 60.0% down) -> (44.5% across, 81.0% down) -> (46.0% across, 97.0% down).
Must show: continuous water; visible shallows at the ford.
Spatial function: Separates the two banks.

east_terrace | The Work Terrace | terrain | supporting | quantity 1. box left 60.0%, top 56.0%, width 26.0%, height 23.0%. An open paved work terrace on the east bank; broken edge stones frame the space but leave the central travel lane clear.
Must show: a broad central movement lane.
Spatial function: Maneuvering and staging space before entering the mill.

ford | The Shallow Ford | terrain | supporting | quantity 1. box left 35.5%, top 77.5%, width 22.5%, height 14.0%. A shallow crossing of pale submerged stones with a readable line of travel across the channel, no deep-water gap.
Must show: at least three cells of passable width; visible shallows rather than a second bridge.
Spatial function: Slower alternate crossing.

mill_entry | South Mill Doorway | doorway | supporting | quantity 1. box left 63.5%, top 43.5%, width 8.5%, height 6.5%. A two-cell-wide opening in the south wall of the mill, without a door leaf or debris across the threshold.
Must show: an actual opening in the wall.
Spatial function: Access from the terrace to the mill interior.

waterwheels | Twin Waterwheels | prop | supporting | quantity 2. box left 49.0%, top 22.0%, width 8.5%, height 23.0%. Two large weathered wooden waterwheels attached to the mill west wall, readable from directly above with their axles pointing toward the mill.
Must show: exactly two separate wheels; attachment to the mill wall.
Spatial function: Distinctive industrial landmark and edge hazard.

west_entry | West Approach | terrain | supporting | quantity 1. box left 12.0%, top 75.0%, width 17.0%, height 17.0%. A broad patch of dry packed earth with sparse grass and enough unoccupied floor for an arriving group.
Must show: clear open ground.
Spatial function: Entry and staging area.

cover_blocks | Fallen Stone Blocks | prop | ambient | quantity 3. box left 77.0%, top 58.0%, width 8.5%, height 17.0%. Three separate fallen sandstone blocks grouped along the eastern terrace edge, with gaps between them and no obstruction to the central approach.
Must show: exactly three blocks.
Spatial function: Optional cover outside the central movement lane.

ROUTES AND ACCESS
bridge_approach: bridge_crossing; West Approach -> The Stone Span -> The Work Terrace. Traversable. Route shape: (20.0% across, 83.5% down) -> (27.0% across, 71.0% down) -> (37.0% across, 62.0% down) -> (48.0% across, 62.0% down) -> (63.0% across, 62.0% down) -> (70.0% across, 67.0% down). A continuous dry approach across the bridge, with the road surface visible between pieces of rubble. Keep a clear width of at least 2 grid cells; the grid need not be drawn.
door_to_interior: corridor; South Mill Doorway -> The Tide Mill. Traversable. Route shape: (68.0% across, 46.7% down) -> (68.0% across, 40.0% down) -> (69.0% across, 33.0% down). An open threshold leading into the visible mill interior. Keep a clear width of at least 2 grid cells; the grid need not be drawn.
ford_approach: trail; West Approach -> The Shallow Ford -> The Work Terrace. Traversable. Route shape: (20.0% across, 83.5% down) -> (34.0% across, 84.0% down) -> (46.0% across, 84.0% down) -> (61.0% across, 83.0% down) -> (70.0% across, 70.0% down). A continuous alternate approach through the shallow ford and back onto the eastern bank. Keep a clear width of at least 3 grid cells; the grid need not be drawn.
terrace_to_door: trail; The Work Terrace -> South Mill Doorway. Traversable. Route shape: (70.0% across, 67.0% down) -> (73.0% across, 54.0% down) -> (68.0% across, 46.7% down). An unobstructed stone approach to the south doorway. Keep a clear width of at least 2 grid cells; the grid need not be drawn.

SPATIAL RELATIONSHIPS
MUST: The Tide Mill east of The Millrace. The mill is on the east bank, with only the waterwheels approaching the water.
MUST: The Stone Span crosses The Millrace. The bridge deck crosses the actual water, not merely points toward it.
MUST: The Shallow Ford south of The Stone Span. The ford is the distinctly separate southern route.
MUST: The Tide Mill north of The Work Terrace. Keep the main approach from the south.

PLAYABILITY
Affordances: two different crossing choices; a two-cell-wide main approach; cover placed away from the central lane; an enterable roofless interior
Preserve: the open south doorway; both crossings; actual navigable floor space; consistent overhead scale
All designated traversable routes need at least 2 cells of clear width.
Compose against an underlying 32 column by 24 row square layout. Each cell represents 5 ft. This is a spacing guide even when no grid is painted.
Keep the declared traversable routes visibly continuous between entry points and objectives; do not seal openings with props or decoration.

GRID, TEXT AND UI
Do not paint a square grid, hex grid, coordinate numbers or grid intersections. Grid setup is handled separately.
Do not paint any titles, names, text, numbers or legends. Location names in these instructions identify objects only; lettering is a separate layer.
Do not draw VTT pins, tokens, mouse pointers, toolbars or interface chrome. 

FINAL PRIORITIES
Required objects, their quantities, spatial relationships and readable routes take precedence over decorative density. Do not replace a difficult required feature with a generic substitute.
Must include: two waterwheels; one stone bridge and one distinct shallow ford; a visible open south doorway
Avoid: painted grids; labels; standing characters or tokens; cinematic camera tilt; deep perspective shadows; decorative rubble blocking routes

setup_steps: Produce and inspect a player-safe base image; keep the editable master specification private.
Open Atlas VTT: Open dashboard in desktop Obsidian; choose the intended collection.
Import the local image with the asset manager + button, then create a scene from the map asset.
Align the grid manually; auto detection is an option for an image with an existing grid, not proof of correct alignment.
Add labels with Atlas text tools or a separately prepared overlay. Link Markdown or Atlas maps with note pins; pins are GM preparation aids.
Place tokens and configure fog, walls and lighting separately in Atlas as needed.
Present the scene in the separate player window, inspect disclosure, then reopen the scene to verify persistence.
calibration_notes: All settings are candidates for manual calibration against the actual imported image.
acceptance_checks: Inspect actual image dimensions and compare several cell spacings across the image after alignment.
Test token snapping and a known movement distance, including hex orientation if applicable.
Inspect the player window for unintended labels, tokens, secrets and revealed areas. Baked image content cannot be removed by GM visibility flags.
Reopen the .atlasmap scene and confirm background, grid and authored objects persist.
